mentions.name: Personalized Language Learning Audio Streams
mentions.description: This platform generates and manages infinite, shareable audio streams for language learners, personalized to the user's interests or specific vocabulary. It also provides live interactive transcripts in a karaoke/teleprompter style, suited for listening while driving or doing chores.
mentions.problem: Intermediate-level learners struggle to find suitable listening content that matches their level and interests, and alternatives like NotebookLM podcasts are a hassle to set up.
mentions.audience: Intermediate-level language learners who want listening content while driving or doing chores.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Personalized audio streams for language learners. Ideal for during driving or while doing chores.

https://listen.longyan.io/

At the intermediate level lots of learners struggle to find suitable content that matches their level and interests, more than a few learners turn to notebookLM podcasts to provide that, but that's a bit of a hassle to set up. So I built a platform that generates and manages infinite and shareable streams around your interests or specific vocabulary. It also provides live interactive transcripts (karaoke / teleprompter style) if you need it.
